card.name: The word times after a number
card.fires_on: The word "times" right after a number word like three or five, as in "three times daily" or "five times the dose". A weaker, rarer hit is Dutch "eens" in "met je eens ben".

modes.label: Times after a count
modes.description: "times" follows three or five and expresses frequency or a multiple.
modes.example: (three<< times>> the recommended dose) and sleep deprivation.

modes.label: Dutch eens
modes.description: The Dutch word "eens" in the phrase for agreeing with someone.
modes.example: "Ik weet niet of ik dat met je<< eens>> ben."
